# do_periodic_segmentation_rust { #mofography.rust_fun.do_periodic_segmentation_rust }

<span class="mg-tag mg-tag-recommended">go-to</span> Primary periodic segmentation pipeline after Rust dgrid.

```python
rust_fun.do_periodic_segmentation_rust(
    dgrid,
    mat_atoms,
    mask_thickness=0.05,
    h=0.2,
    min_distance=1.5,
    threshold_abs=1.5,
    preserve_threshold=3.0,
    smooth_threshold=6.0,
    max_smooth_radius=2.0,
    return_padded_regions=False,
    spacing=None,
    minimum_window_separation=None,
    wall_thickness=0.05,
    extra_padding=5,
    compactness=0,
    min_region_size=0.001,
    disable_tqdm=False,
    compute_connections=True,
    return_dgrid=False,
    watershed_backend='rust_det',
    watershed_connectivity=2,
    skip_endchannel_pairs=True,
    vdw_radii_set=None,
    vdw_radii_angstrom=None,
    check_plr=True,
)
```

Perform periodic segmentation on a distance grid to identify pore regions.

This function implements a comprehensive pore segmentation algorithm that:
1. Detects local maxima in the distance field
2. Applies periodic boundary conditions
3. Performs watershed segmentation
4. Identifies connections between regions
5. Returns detailed segmentation results

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name                      | Type          | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                   | Default      |
|---------------------------|---------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|--------------|
| dgrid                     | numpy.ndarray | 3D distance grid from dgrid_from_atoms_rust                                                                                                                                                                                   | _required_   |
| mat_atoms                 | ase.Atoms     | ASE Atoms object of the material                                                                                                                                                                                              | _required_   |
| mask_thickness            | float         | Threshold for void space identification                                                                                                                                                                                       | `0.05`       |
| check_plr                 | bool          | Run the legacy lattice pore-limiting-radius sanity check on ``dgrid`` (warns if ``mask_thickness`` exceeds it; never alters ``mask_thickness``). Set False to skip the check, e.g. for large porous carbons where it is slow. | `True`       |
| h                         | float         | Persistence parameter for maxima detection                                                                                                                                                                                    | `0.2`        |
| min_distance              | float         | Minimum distance of separationg required between distinct local maxima                                                                                                                                                        | `1.5`        |
| threshold_abs             | float         | Absolute threshold for maxima detection                                                                                                                                                                                       | `1.5`        |
| preserve_threshold        | float         | Distance cutoff (Å) below which maxima are untouched during smoothing                                                                                                                                                         | `3.0`        |
| smooth_threshold          | float         | Distance threshold (Å) above which maxima are always smoothed                                                                                                                                                                 | `6.0`        |
| max_smooth_radius         | float         | Maximum radius (Å) used when smoothing maxima                                                                                                                                                                                 | `2.0`        |
| return_padded_regions     | bool          | Whether to return padded region arrays                                                                                                                                                                                        | `False`      |
| spacing                   | float \| None | Grid spacing. If None, estimated from dgrid size and cell lengths. Specify for better accuracy.                                                                                                                               | `None`       |
| minimum_window_separation | float \| None | Minimum separation for window connections                                                                                                                                                                                     | `None`       |
| wall_thickness            | float         | Thickness of wall regions to exclude                                                                                                                                                                                          | `0.05`       |
| extra_padding             | float         | Additional padding for periodic calculations in angstroms. This over and above the standard_padding + 5 A cushion.                                                                                                            | `5`          |
| compactness               | float         | Watershed compactness parameter                                                                                                                                                                                               | `0`          |
| min_region_size           | float         | Minimum region size as fraction of total volume, regions smaller than this in comparison with the *padded_grid* are removed                                                                                                   | `0.001`      |
| disable_tqdm              | bool          | Whether to disable progress bars                                                                                                                                                                                              | `False`      |
| compute_connections       | bool          | Whether to compute inter-region connections                                                                                                                                                                                   | `True`       |
| return_dgrid              | bool          | Whether to include dgrid in output                                                                                                                                                                                            | `False`      |
| watershed_backend         | str           | Which watershed backend to use: "rust_det" (default, deterministic Rust heap), "rust_bucket" (parallel bucket flood), "rust_det_parallel" (deterministic parallel), or "skimage".                                             | `'rust_det'` |
| skip_endchannel_pairs     |               | If True (default), do not merge tiny wall-touching end-channel slivers into neighbors. Set False only for cosmetic visualization cleanup.                                                                                     | `True`       |
| watershed_connectivity    | int           | Connectivity for skimage watershed (2=18-NN, 3=26-NN). Only used when watershed_backend="skimage".                                                                                                                            | `2`          |
| vdw_radii_set             |               | Name of the VDW table used to build ``dgrid`` (e.g. ``bondi_crc_fallback``, ``mendeleev``). Recorded in ``input_params``; default ``bondi_crc_fallback``.                                                                     | `None`       |
| vdw_radii_angstrom        |               | Per-atom radii (Å) used for ``dgrid``, if recording a custom array (sets ``vdw_radii_set`` to ``array`` when omitted).                                                                                                        | `None`       |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description                                                                             |
|--------|--------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | dict   | Dictionary containing segmentation results including maxima, regions, connections, etc. |
